{{Top|leg}}
'''Pouchfish''' were native to the shallow seas of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] and kept their [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in a large brood pouch until they hatched. The [[Sedrian]]s discovered that the pouchfish would open the brood pouch if the insides of its gills were rubbed, and they maintained schools of them for use as living containers.
